challenges.title: Exchange Requested Without Sales Receipt
challenges.shortDescription: Guide a customer who received an ill-fitting jacket as a gift through no-receipt exchange policy.
challenges.mission: Explain store policy politely, check barcode and price tags, and offer store credit or size exchange.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: My sister gifted me this leather jacket for my birthday, but it's a size Medium and I need an XL. I don't have the paper bill because it was a surprise gift, but the tags are still on. Can I swap it?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting the right size without troubling the gift giver

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Shows the intact tags and seeks assistance.

challenges.title: Exchanging Opened Perfume After First Spray
challenges.shortDescription: Tactfully handle a customer demanding to swap an expensive perfume after breaking the cellophane seal.
challenges.mission: Enforce hygiene and return policy gently, explain why opened cosmetics cannot be resold, and offer alternative fragrance layering solutions.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I bought this Eau de Parfum two hours ago, sprayed it once in my car, and it gives me a terrible headache. I want to swap it for the floral version. Take this bottle back.

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: not wasting 6,000 rupees on a perfume they dislike

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Argues that only one spray was used and bottle is virtually full.
hiddenObjectives: Check manager discretion or tester samples

challenges.title: Clearance Item Marked "Final Sale - No Return"
challenges.shortDescription: Assist an upset mother who bought the wrong shoe size from the clearance rack marked non-exchangeable.
challenges.mission: Empathize with the mother situation while respecting clearance guidelines, exploring size availability on the discount rack.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I bought these school shoes for my son from the red tag rack this morning, but his feet won't fit into them! The cashier stamped 'Final Sale', but please, I cannot afford to throw this money away!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting wearable shoes for her child

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Presents the unworn shoes and asks for human compassion over strict rules.
hiddenObjectives: Check clearance rack for next size up
Seek supervisor override for like-for-like swap
possibleSolutions: One-time supervisor override for size exchange

challenges.title: Online Click-and-Collect Color Mismatch
challenges.shortDescription: Resolve an issue where an in-store pickup parcel contained beige instead of charcoal, with no local store stock remaining.
challenges.mission: Acknowledge warehouse fulfillment error, arrange free home express delivery from central warehouse, and compensate for trip.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I ordered this formal blazer online in Charcoal Black and drove 45 minutes to pick it up here. I just opened the parcel in your store and it's Light Beige! And your colleague says you don't even have Black in stock!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting the black blazer by tomorrow without traveling again

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Demands an immediate solution that does not require another store visit.
hiddenObjectives: Book express courier from central hub
Offer complimentary home delivery with discount voucher
possibleSolutions: Immediate full refund and promo code
